items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE complete hand-painted game platform object: a single enormous CLOSED lying old folio, wide and low, exactly one coherent leather-bound book. Isolate on solid pure #FF00FF magenta chroma background; do not use magenta inside the object; no cast shadow or scenery. Wide landscape canvas, center the object with generous 8% magenta safe margin on every side. One single book only.
